title: A Unified Kalman-Type Classification of Controllability for Linear Stochastic Systems
summary: We provide a unified algebraic classification of approximate controllability, approximate null controllability, exact null controllability, and exact controllability for finite-dimensional linear stochastic control systems with constant coefficients and multidimensional Brownian noise. The controls may enter both the drift and the diffusion terms, and the joint diffusion-control matrix may have arbitrary rank. A finite decreasing sequence of subspaces defines a common geometric obstruction. Its vanishing characterizes the two approximate properties and exact null controllability. Exact…
